metadata.description: Representative discovery and demo corpus. Clause summaries and QCO flags are indicative, not an official BIS register or complete reproduction of any standard. Verify current editions, amendments, product scope, and Quality Control Orders with BIS and the responsible ministry before procurement or legal use.

standards.title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
standards.scope: TMT reinforcement bars including Fe 500D grades for reinforced concrete.

mandatory_clauses.title: Tensile and bend properties
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Supply grade-specific tensile, elongation, bend and rebend test evidence; values must comply with the applicable grade table and amendments.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Tensile test and bend/rebend tests per referenced methods

mandatory_clauses.title: Heat chemistry and weldability
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Heat analysis and carbon-equivalent limits shall comply with the selected grade and applicable table.

standards.title: Plain and reinforced concrete — Code of practice
standards.scope: Design and construction provisions for plain and reinforced concrete structures.

mandatory_clauses.title: Materials and concrete quality
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Concrete materials, mix proportioning, production and acceptance shall meet the specified grade and applicable durability provisions.

mandatory_clauses.title: Reinforcement detailing
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Reinforcement design, development length, cover and detailing shall be shown and executed to the applicable exposure and structural provisions.

standards.title: 43 grade ordinary Portland cement — Specification
standards.scope: 43 grade ordinary Portland cement for general construction.

mandatory_clauses.title: Physical requirements
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Cement shall satisfy the applicable fineness, setting-time, soundness and strength requirements for 43 grade.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Tests from applicable parts of IS 4031

mandatory_clauses.title: Identification and certification
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Bags and delivery documentation shall identify grade, manufacturer, batch and applicable BIS licence/mark where compulsory certification applies.

standards.title: Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel — Specification
standards.scope: Hot-rolled structural steel products; grade and quality designation depend on product form and thickness.

mandatory_clauses.title: Chemical composition and mechanical properties
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Grade, quality, thickness, chemistry and mechanical properties shall meet the applicable product table and delivery condition.

mandatory_clauses.title: Heat traceability and test certificate
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Each supplied lot shall be traceable to its heat and accompanied by agreed mill test results, including impact testing when specified.

standards.title: Drinking water — Specification
standards.scope: Acceptability requirements for drinking water at the point of supply, including permissible limits under specified conditions.

mandatory_clauses.title: Organoleptic and physicochemical limits
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Reported results shall meet acceptable limits or justified permissible limits and identify the chosen sample point.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Sampling and tests using applicable IS 3025 methods

mandatory_clauses.title: Pathogen safety
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Water shall meet the microbiological requirements in the current standard; absence of key indicators must be demonstrated by a competent laboratory.

standards.title: PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords for working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: PVC insulated cables for fixed wiring and related applications within specified voltage and conductor constructions.

mandatory_clauses.title: Conductor and insulation
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Conductor class/size, insulation type, sheath, voltage rating and marking shall match the specified cable type.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Constructional verification and conductor resistance test

mandatory_clauses.title: Voltage withstand and insulation
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Cable samples shall pass the applicable routine/type tests, including voltage withstand and insulation-resistance tests.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Electrical tests per IS 694 and referenced methods

standards.title: Cross-linked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables — Part 1: For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed power cables up to 1.1 kV; verify current amendments and product scope.

mandatory_clauses.title: Cable construction and armour
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Conductor, XLPE insulation, sheath, armour where specified, dimensions and voltage designation shall comply with the applicable type.

mandatory_clauses.title: Electrical and performance tests
mandatory_clauses.requirement: The prescribed routine, sample and type tests shall be documented for the supplied design and batch.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Referenced electrical, mechanical and ageing tests

standards.title: Code of practice for earthing
standards.scope: Guidance for system earthing, protective earthing and earthing conductors/electrodes.

key_parameters.protective_conductor: sized for fault duty and installation

mandatory_clauses.title: Earthing arrangement and fault duty
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Design shall state the earthing arrangement, conductor sizing, fault-current duty and electrode layout appropriate to site conditions.

mandatory_clauses.title: Continuity and earth measurements
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Protective conductor continuity and electrode/system performance shall be measured and recorded against project criteria.

standards.title: Switches for domestic and similar purposes — Specification
standards.scope: Manual switches for fixed electrical installations in domestic and similar premises.

mandatory_clauses.title: Rated values and safe construction
mandatory_clauses.requirement: The declared current, voltage, terminal arrangement and enclosure shall be suitable for the intended installation and comply with the applicable product classification.

mandatory_clauses.title: Electrical endurance and temperature rise
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Switches shall pass applicable endurance, temperature-rise, dielectric and abnormal-operation tests.

standards.title: Insulating mats for electrical purposes — Specification
standards.scope: Insulating mats for use in electrical installations, classified by voltage class and thickness.

mandatory_clauses.title: Voltage class and dimensions
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Mat voltage class, thickness, surface and size shall be declared and appropriate to the installation risk assessment.

mandatory_clauses.title: Dielectric strength and insulation
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Each applicable class shall meet the prescribed dielectric and insulation tests with batch traceability.

standards.title: Information technology equipment — Safety — Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for covered IT equipment; current CRS inclusion and applicable transition notices must be checked.

key_parameters.electric_shock_protection: Class I or Class II as designed

mandatory_clauses.title: Protection from electric shock and fire
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Covered product shall satisfy the applicable electrical, fire and mechanical safety requirements and hold the registration required by current CRS scope.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Accredited laboratory safety test and CRS registration verification

mandatory_clauses.title: Rating and registration identification
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Required rating labels, manufacturer identity and valid registration details shall be present on the product/packaging as applicable.

standards.title: Audio, video and similar electronic apparatus — Safety requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for covered audio/video and similar apparatus; verify current CRS product scope.

mandatory_clauses.title: Protection against electrical and fire hazards
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Apparatus shall meet the applicable safety construction, insulation, temperature and abnormal-operation requirements.

mandatory_clauses.title: CRS coverage and identification
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Where the product is covered, valid CRS registration and required identification shall be verified before supply.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: CRS record and product label inspection

standards.title: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes — Safety requirements for lithium systems
standards.scope: Safety of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries; part and product scope must be matched carefully.

mandatory_clauses.title: Abuse and fault-condition safety
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Applicable cell/battery design shall pass the specified electrical, mechanical and environmental abuse tests without unacceptable hazards.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Tests selected from applicable IS 16046 part and product category

mandatory_clauses.title: Cell identity and registration
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Cell model, pack configuration, manufacturer and applicable CRS registration shall be traceable to the offered product.

standards.title: Room air conditioners — Part 1: Unitary air conditioners
standards.scope: Room air conditioners; performance rating and energy-label requirements depend on current BEE schedules and product category.

mandatory_clauses.title: Cooling capacity and efficiency
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Declared capacity, power input and efficiency shall be tested using the applicable product method and current BEE label schedule.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Calorimeter/psychrometric performance test per applicable method

mandatory_clauses.title: Electrical and operating safety
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Ratings, protection, refrigerant and installation conditions shall be suitable for the specified supply and operating environment.

standards.title: Steel tubes, tubulars and other wrought steel fittings — Part 1: Steel tubes
standards.scope: Steel tubes for water, gas, air and steam service in applicable light, medium and heavy classes.

mandatory_clauses.title: Tube class and tolerances
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Nominal bore, class, outside diameter, wall thickness, mass and end finish shall match the applicable table.

mandatory_clauses.title: Hydrostatic and material quality
mandatory_clauses.requirement: The supplied tubes shall meet the prescribed hydrostatic and applicable material tests and be traceable to the batch.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Hydrostatic test and chemical/mechanical tests where specified

standards.title: Horizontal centrifugal pumps for clear, cold water — Specification
standards.scope: Horizontal centrifugal pumps for clear cold water under specified operating and installation conditions.

key_parameters.test_acceptance: guarantee point and tolerances per purchase spec

mandatory_clauses.title: Duty point and efficiency
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Offered pump shall meet the specified flow/head duty and guaranteed performance within agreed tolerances.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Hydraulic performance test at agreed test facility

mandatory_clauses.title: Construction and documentation
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Wetted materials, seals, motor data and inspection/test certificates shall be declared and suitable for clear-water service.

standards.title: Fire extinguishers — Carbon dioxide type — Specification
standards.scope: Carbon dioxide portable fire extinguishers, capacity and ratings selected for the intended hazard and application.

mandatory_clauses.title: Pressure vessel and extinguishing medium
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Cylinder, valve, hose/horn, charge and safety devices shall be suitable for the declared extinguisher type and capacity.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Hydrostatic/pressure and component tests as applicable

mandatory_clauses.title: Discharge, inspection and identification
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Discharge performance, inspection interval, refill information and required product certification/marking shall be verified.

standards.title: Protective clothing for industrial workers exposed to heat — Performance requirements
standards.scope: Heat-protective clothing; selected performance class must match the workplace hazard and applicable edition.

key_parameters.flame_spread: class and test method to be specified
key_parameters.garment_design: cover body areas identified by hazard assessment

mandatory_clauses.title: Thermal hazard protection
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Garment shall be selected and tested for the declared heat/flame hazards and the performance class shall be documented.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Thermal, flame and heat-transfer tests specified by applicable edition

mandatory_clauses.title: Coverage, closure and maintenance
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Design, closures, compatibility, size range, cleaning and retirement instructions shall be stated for safe use.

standards.title: Industrial safety helmets — Specification
standards.scope: Industrial protective helmets for head protection; verify current amendments and intended use conditions.

key_parameters.impact_absorption: pass applicable conditioning and impact tests
key_parameters.electrical_class: declare if required by hazard assessment

mandatory_clauses.title: Impact and penetration protection
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Helmet shell and harness shall pass applicable impact, penetration and conditioning requirements for the declared type.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Impact and penetration tests using specified conditioning

mandatory_clauses.title: Manufacturer, date and adjustment
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Helmet shall carry legible identification and be supplied with compatible, adjustable harness and user instructions.

standards.title: Personal protective equipment — Safety footwear — Part 2: Requirements and test methods for safety footwear
standards.scope: Safety footwear for professional use; protection category and features shall match the workplace risk.

key_parameters.toe_protection: category and impact level specified by risk

mandatory_clauses.title: Toe and sole protection
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Footwear shall declare the protection category and pass the applicable impact/compression and sole tests for the hazards specified.
mandatory_clauses.testing_method: Impact, compression, penetration and slip tests as applicable

mandatory_clauses.title: Size, construction and identification
mandatory_clauses.requirement: Size, model, materials and protective features shall be identifiable; footwear shall be suitable for the work environment.
